note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent auditor who did not author the working-tree changes. RFC 8955 Section 4 read in rfc/full/rfc8955.txt: "When advertising Flow Specifications, the Length of the Next-Hop Network Address MUST be set to 0.  The Network Address of the Next-Hop field MUST be ignored." Default-path implementation verified across every origination and forwarding rail: ze-bgp-conf.yang declares session/flowspec-redirect-next-hop default false (PeerSettings.FlowSpecRedirectNextHop defaults false, parsed in reactor/config.go, restart-scoped under fail-closed hotSwappableSettings, and partitioned in announceFacts). On the default configuration path (false), BuildFlowSpec, BuildPlugin/buildMPReachPlugin, buildBatchAnnounceUpdate, sendStaleReadvertise, buildRIBRouteUpdate/buildRIBRouteUpdateWithRedirect (both opQueue drains), forwardUpdateCore, reactorForwardRS and relayStoredRoutes (via precomputeRedirectNextHop -> redirectStrip and applyNextHopFamily/applyRedirectNextHop) unconditionally emit zero-length MP_REACH_NLRI next hops, including for routes carrying the 0x0800 redirect-to-IP extended community. All four audit questions and both polarities pass across all six tagged units: TestFlowSpecUpdateIgnoresConfiguredNextHop (BuildFlowSpec, IPv4/IPv6 configured hops), TestFlowSpecOriginationOmitsConfiguredNextHop (config, API batch, both queue drains across IPv4/IPv6 flow and flow-vpn with absent/IPv4/IPv6 hops), TestFlowSpecForwardingOmitsNextHop (all 4 FlowSpec families, unchanged/self/explicit4/explicit6, empty/peer-address/ipv6 received hops), TestFlowSpecRouteServerOmitsNextHop (live RS + RIB + TCP across all 4 families and modes), TestFlowSpecForwardingKeepsLegacyNextHop (mixed UPDATE isolation), test/encode/flow-encode.ci (real daemon on default config, exact zero-length wire frames for all 13 SAFI 133/134 routes including seq 2 copy-to-nexthop and seq 8/9 redirect-to-nexthop-draft), and TestFlowSpecDefaultPathOmitsRedirectNextHop (PeersFromTree default/false parsing, default-path origination across all 4 rails for rate-limit and IPv4/IPv6 0x0800, and default-path IPv4/IPv6 0x0800 forwarding strip). The explicitly selected draft-simpson-idr-flowspec-redirect-02 Section 3 opt-in (session flowspec-redirect-next-hop true) is tested in untagged compatibility controls (TestFlowSpecRedirectNextHopOptIn, simple-flow.ci) and documented as Counted: No in rfc/short/rfc8955.md.
upgrade_reason: Addressed all three findings from the 2026-11-23 weak verdict: (1) moved all opt-in session flowspec-redirect-next-hop true (draft-simpson) checks out of TestFlowSpecDefaultPathOmitsRedirectNextHop into an untagged compatibility control TestFlowSpecRedirectNextHopOptIn, (2) added default-path IPv6 0x0800 forwarding strip coverage (forward/default-ipv6-strips) and narrowed both RFC8955-4-3 tags on TestFlowSpecDefaultPathOmitsRedirectNextHop strictly to default-path zero-length next-hop enforcement for IPv4 and IPv6 with refreshed discrimination records, and (3) added the explicit scope-record section and table for the opt-in extension (Counted: No) to rfc/short/rfc8955.md.
